亚联邦-天穹星域-天穹总殿

第七十六层天穹之壁

一道道身影从走廊缓缓走来，伴随着嘈杂的声音，这里是整个亚联邦近乎最重要的地方，本该是无比地肃穆，但这里驻守的士兵却怀揣着尊敬与钦佩的眼神望向这一群人。

“请诸位随我来，殿主已经等候多时了”一名身穿军服的中年男子身体微倾；

“哈哈，小张，今天怎么是你亲自过来接我了，叶落那臭小子在干啥呢？”

“木老，您跟我来就知道了”张天正努力挤出一丝微笑，但自从知道那件事后，他实在是没有心情开玩笑了，他相信，进了这个门，出来了应该没人笑得出来。

“嗯？这小子”那个被称为木老的老者以及其他人也是察觉到了一丝不对劲。

很快众人都坐到了桌子两边，张天正也坐到了自己的位置上。

“今天的会议倒是多了不少人呢”主位之下左边第一个位置上，一道绝美的身影扫视着后边坐着的黑压压一片人，

“龙绝大人，失敬了”

“龙影姐姐，我在这！”人群中，传出了一声清脆的声音，

龙影摇了摇头，“这丫头”，“叶落究竟在搞什么，竟然把几乎全联邦的震世级强者以及宙之战略者都喊了过来，但穆萱好像没来，奇怪，”

这时，众人面前的空间一阵扭曲，一道人影从空间中闪出，“咳”

听到这一声咳嗽，众人皆是脸色一变，站了起来，

“叶小子，你受伤了？”

“木悬大人，我没事，不过是空间碎片罢了”叶落向木悬摆了摆手，

Page (1/3)

Asia Federation - Sky Dome Star Region - Sky Dome Main Hall

The seventy-sixth floor of the sky wall

Figures walked slowly from the corridor, accompanied by noisy voices. This is almost the most important place in the entire Asian Federation. It should be extremely solemn, but the soldiers stationed here look at this group of people with respect and admiration.

"Please follow me, the master of the palace has been waiting for a long time." A middle-aged man in military uniform leaned slightly;

"Haha, Xiao Zhang, why did you come to pick me up in person today? What is that brat Ye Luo doing?"

"Mr. Mu, you will know if you come with me." Zhang Tianzheng tried his best to squeeze out a smile, but since knowing that incident, he was really in no mood to joke. He believed that no one would be able to laugh after entering this door and coming out.

"Huh? This boy" The old man known as Mu Lao and others also noticed something was wrong.

Soon everyone sat on both sides of the table, and Zhang Tianzheng also took his seat.

"There are a lot of people in today's meeting." From the first position on the left under the main seat, a beautiful figure glanced at the dark crowd sitting behind,

"Lord Long Jue, I'm disrespectful."

"Sister Longying, I'm here!" A clear voice came from the crowd,

Long Ying shook his head, "This girl", "What on earth is Ye Luo doing? He actually called almost all the world-shattering powerhouses and Zhou Zhi strategists in the federation, but Mu Xuan didn't seem to come. It's strange,"

At this time, the space in front of everyone was distorted, and a figure flashed out of the space, "Cough"

Hearing this cough, everyone's expressions changed and they stood up.

"Boy Ye, are you injured?"

"Master Mu Xuan, I'm fine, it's just space debris." Ye Luo waved his hand to Mu Xuan.
